hfs.note: The hop was compromised through Rejetto HFS CVE-2026-61500 by forging an admin cookie from Math.random() sid values. A scan alone is not this stage.

keys.note: An SSH key was appended to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys after the HFS middleware hooks ran commands.

hop.note: The ZULT download failed. The actor returned over SSH, stood up an unauthenticated HTTP server, and installed Nmap and Chisel. The profile covers the host activity, not a successful implant.

sms.note: CVE-2026-16232 Run Script tasks copied the firewall database and Internal CA, minted pivot.p12, and unloaded security policies. The profile's file-burst hypothesis is only a starting point for the policy unload.

preload.note: A failed certificate task's error showed /usr/lib/.libproc.so in /etc/ld.so.preload. GreyNoise calls that a possible implant. The same day-two window added an nftables rule on the hop.

agents.note: GreyNoise suspects separate agentic harnesses and does not name a model or framework. The profile is not confirmation that a victim ran an agent.
